description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Ship goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Shipping" name="Goods to be shipped">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Clarify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Secretary clarifies who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Clarify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Clarify_Choice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingChoice" name="Choose shipping method" default="Flow_Choice_Normal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Clarify_Choice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Choice_Special</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Choice_Normal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Secretary invites three logistics companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Choice_Special</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invite_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invite_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_SelectCompany</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Secretary selects one logistics company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_SelectCompany</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_MergeShipping</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Choice_Normal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Normal_MergeShipping</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeShipping" name="Shipping method chosen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_MergeShipping</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Normal_MergeShipping</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare shipment in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Package</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Label</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_InsuranceChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Warehousemen package the goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Package</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Package_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Secretary writes a package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Label</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Label_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceChoice" name="Is parcel insurance necessary?" default="Flow_InsuranceNotNeeded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_InsuranceChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceNotNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Logistics department head takes parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceTask_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeInsurance" name="Insurance decision complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceTask_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceNotNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="All shipment preparation ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Package_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Label_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_PreparePickup</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by the logistics company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_PreparePickup</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparePickup_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparePickup_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Clarify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Shipping" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clarify_Choice" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Special" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingChoice" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">largeAmount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Normal" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingChoice" targetRef="Task_NormalPost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_ReceiveOffers" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_SelectCompany" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_MergeShipping" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_MergeShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Normal_MergeShipping" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_MergeShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeShipping" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Package" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Label" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_InsuranceChoice" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_Join" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNeeded" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceChoice" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceTask_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_MergeInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNotNeeded" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MergeInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_PreparePickup" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparePickup_End" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
